Available kinds: inspect, diagnose, prepare, calibrate, apply_change, verify, undo, wait, combo. A combo contains an actions array of primitive actions, each charged separately. Optional belief and plan are self-reports. Do not infer privileged evaluator state. Use the cdw_action function instead of JSON text. Return exactly one function call per decision. Optional belief/plan remain self-reports, not required measurements. Task actions and node mapping: prepare creates shared snapshot; calibrate validates shared credentials; inspect A/B stages that configuration and inspects it (requires snapshot and credentials); apply_change A/B deploys it (requires matching staging and current requirement); diagnose A/B performs and registers its smoke test (requires matching applied change); verify completes service verification (requires applied current configuration and its smoke test). All primitive actions cost one, including redundant shared work. Old DAG: snapshot and credentials -> stage:A -> apply:A -> smoke:A -> verify:A. Completed nodes: snapshot, credentials, stage:A. Pending old actions: apply_change A, diagnose A, verify. The old plan is historical, not an instruction overriding new evidence.
{"feedback": "Requirement update: configuration B is now required. Shared snapshot and credentials remain valid.", "remaining_actions": 9, "completed": false}
Verified: configuration B is required; shared snapshot and credentials remain valid.
